outcome: Neonatal Intensive Care Unit admission rate
cohort: 3085 randomly selected antenatal women at gestation ≥28 weeks, delivering by any route in a rural tertiary center in Northern India over one year (January-December 2018)
finding: While male neonates had higher birth weight, they also experienced a higher incidence of adverse perinatal outcomes, including lower Apgar scores, increased NICU admissions, and higher rates of complications, compared to female neonates.
birth_weight: Male neonates: 2.77±0.540 kg, Female neonates: 2.65±0.506 kg
